subgoals: Recognise the sum as their limit

visual.title: Partial sums approach the limit
visual.caption: The partial sums add one term at a time. Their sequence is plotted in green and its limit is the sum of the series.

predict.question: What happens to the partial sums of 1/n?
predict.explain: The harmonic series diverges, so its partial sums grow without bound even though the terms tend to zero.
